title: Covering design C(22,15,6)
statement: Find 15-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 22} such that every 6-subset lies in some block, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 45 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 15 distinct points from 1..22 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(22,15,6) = 45 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-25 (before it 46); read 6 Nov 2026
